text:
Maria G: quick follow-up from the RFC review — we need a short convo on future-proofing the usage event contract before the proto lands. main concern: backward compatibility + auditability
Ben P: +1. main risk is late-arrivals and how we surface provenance for retroactive corrections
Carla S: are we leaning envelope_v2 (bigger payload) or additive optional fields? both have pros/cons
Eli K: envelope_v2 buys us a clean break: explicit version, structured provenance, polymorphic payloads. downside = rollout pain for downstream consumers
Maria G: rollout pain is real for partners (billing, analytics). thought: opt-in header for v2, and a compatibility shim in ingest that rewrites to v1 for older pipelines
Ben P: shim approach OK, but shims add operational burden. we need canonicalization rules + test harness for the shim transforms
Carla S: also think about token accounting: v2 should include token_breakdown array so we can attribute subtokens to model variants later
Eli K: token_breakdown is helpful but increases event size significantly for high-token calls. maybe sample breakdown only when a flag set or when tokens > N
Maria G: sampling logic needs deterministic selection (so audits reproducible). prefer hash-based sampling on request_id
Ben P: agree deterministic. also need dedupe_id semantics documented. who generates it? client vs ingest?
Carla S: proposal: clients continue to supply client_request_id (opaque), ingest always writes dedupe_id = sha256(tenant||client_request_id||ingest_ts_floor) so different ingestion windows don't collide unexpectedly
Eli K: +1. that gives us idempotency across retries and clear ownership of dedupe logic. record the fingerprint algorithm in the envelope meta
InfraBot: deploy-checklist: shim-service, schema-gate, canary-config, observability-dashboard, backfill-plan
Maria G: about audits — v2 should carry an audit_trace array: events that led to final charge (e.g., partial refunds, adjustments). this lets downstream reconcile without re-querying per-tenant ledgers
Ben P: audit_trace helpful but we must cap it (max_entries) and offload heavy traces to artifact store with an artefact_url in the event
Carla S: agree. artefact_url + signed short-lived URL solves payload bloat and keeps events bounded
Eli K: migration plan idea: 1) release v2 schema in registry as opt-in 2) start emitting v2 for internal tenants 3) enable shim that translates v2->v1 for public consumers 4) run canary comparing v1 vs v2-derived billing for 2 billing cycles 5) decide on cutover
Maria G: timeline: want step 1 within 2 weeks, canary start in ~6 weeks. need owners for shim, canary metrics, and backfill strategy
Ben P: I'll own the shim and canary metric comparisons (latency and cost deltas, plus token accounting diffs)
Carla S: I'll own schema registry + docs + compatibility tests
Eli K: I'll handle audit artifact store + signed url pattern and add sampling deterministic config
Maria G: open questions: how to version contract for ephemeral experimental fields? suggested: use feature_flags in envelope.meta and treat them as schema-safe (no breaking) until promoted to vN field
Ben P: sounds good. also add explicit "billing_granule" field to avoid downstream inference of tenant billing windows from event timestamps
Carla S: minuta: add example envelope snippet to the RFC thread. quick mock: ```json
{
  "version": "2",
  "tenant": "tenant_foo",
  "client_request_id": "abc123",
  "dedupe_id": "sha256:...",
  "token_count": 123,
  "token_breakdown": [ {"model": "x", "tokens": 100}, {"model": "y", "tokens": 23} ],
  "billing_granule": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/PT1H",
  "audit_trace": [{"type": "adjustment", "id": "adj-1", "amount": -30}],
  "artefact_url": "https://artifacts/internal/trace/xyz?sig=...",
  "meta": {"sampling_hash": "0xabc", "feature_flags": ["token_breakdown"] }
}
```
Eli K: that mock covers most bases. ensure we include a size budget: events > 4KB trigger artefact_url flow
Maria G: agreed. action items: Ben (shim + canary), Carla (schema + tests + docs), Eli (artifact store + size gate), myself (rollout coordination + partner comms). I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to confirm milestones
Ben P: +1 :thumbsup:
Carla S: :rocket:
Eli K: thanks all
Maria G: thanks — closing thread for now, will post RFC update after syncing with infra
